text:
Maya Patel: Quick thread to lock release notes & internal announce timing for the v1.12.3 rollout tomorrow.
Maya Patel: Draft blurb below — can people eyeball for clarity and embargo language? paste for copy review:
Maya Patel: ```Heads-up: Tomorrow we’re shipping v1.12.3 — improved batching, reduced token cost for embeddings, and a fix for kv cache evictions. Expect short maintenance window (~5–10m) for warmup. If you rely on Dedicated capacity, pin to v1.12.2 for business-critical paths until 24h after rollout.``` 
Sam Rivera: Looks good. Suggest changing "short maintenance window" -> "brief service warmup" (less alarming).
Jordan Chen: +1 to Sam. Also add note about canary: we plan 10% traffic canary for first 30m, auto-rollforward if no errors > 5xx rate threshold 0.5%.
Lee Thompson: Ops: are we comfortable with pin guidance? some customers require pin to last-stable for 48h.
Maya Patel: Good catch — updated line: "pin to v1.12.2 for critical paths until 48h unless you’ve validated on staging." 
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: staging at 2025-11-12T18:00Z, prod canary at 2025-11-13T21:00Z -> 10% for 30m -> gradual rollout to 100% over next 2h.
OpsOncall: I'll own the 21:00-23:30 watch. If error rate > 0.5% or latency p95 regresses >200ms trigger rollback.
Sam Rivera: Legal requested brief mention of data handling: "no new customer data retention changes in this release" — can we add short sentence? 
Maya Patel: Inserted. New draft below:
Maya Patel: ```Heads-up: Tomorrow we’re shipping v1.12.3 — improved batching, reduced token cost for embeddings, and a fix for kv cache evictions. Expect brief service warmup (~5–10m) for model instances. No changes to customer data retention. If you rely on Dedicated capacity, pin to v1.12.2 for critical paths until 48h after rollout unless validated on staging.``` 
Jordan Chen: Microcopy nit: change "model instances" -> "inference instances". 
Maya Patel: Done. Final: ```Heads-up: Tomorrow we’re shipping v1.12.3 — improved batching, reduced token cost for embeddings, and a fix for kv cache evictions. Expect brief inference instance warmup (~5–10m). No changes to customer data retention. If you rely on Dedicated capacity, pin to v1.12.2 for critical paths until 48h after rollout unless validated on staging.``` 
Lee Thompson: Approved from Ops. 
Sam Rivera: Approved from Product. 
DeployBot: Reminder: add deploy note to internal RN doc and set embargo until 21:30Z on prod day.
Maya Patel: @OpsOncall can you confirm embargo lift time? OpsOncall: Confirmed — embargo lift 21:30Z, announce internal channel then. External customer-facing notes go out 24h later.
Maya Patel: One last check: rollback command and pin instructions for CS. Paste for ops/CS digest:
Maya Patel: ```Rollback: /deploy rollback v1.12.2 --force
Pin customer: API header X-Model-Pin: v1.12.2 or via Console -> Model Versions -> Pin``` 
Jordan Chen: Copy for CS looks fine. Maybe shorter command example: `curl -X POST /pin -d '{"model":"v1.12.2"}'` for self-serve docs.
Maya Patel: Added to notes. Everyone good? If no objections I'll post internal announce at 21:15Z to eng-releases and product channels and tag CS. 
Sam Rivera: Go for it. :thumbsup:
Lee Thompson: Go. OpsOncall: Standing by.
DeployBot: Canary window set. Monitoring hooks enabled. Good luck!
